language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Saved to your account and used on your other devices too.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Applies at once and is saved to your account, so it follows you to other devices.

profile.heading: Profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.nameHint: Shown instead of your user name. Leave empty to use the user name.
profile.hidden: Hide my account from public user lists
profile.hiddenHint: Apps that list accounts on their sign-in screen will not show you.

password.heading: Change password
password.hint: After the change every device, including this one, is signed out.
password.rule: At least {min} bytes; nothing is trimmed.
password.tooShort: The new password must be at least {min} bytes long.
password.tooLong: The new password must be at most {max} bytes long.
password.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
password.changed: Password changed. Sign in again with the new password.
